dialogues.speaker: Tattered Volume
dialogues.text: (This appears to just be an ordinary fairy tale in which a kind-hearted girl makes friends with a white pigeon, after which they travel the world together.)

dialogues.speaker: Ancient Volume
dialogues.text: (Some of the pages have been torn out for reasons unknown, and the ink has almost completely faded. The cover has beautiful golden words inscribed on it: "Kitezhgrad Publishing House.")
